name: location-picker

frames.best_why: A settled 432 Orchard Ave address, its walk time and an enabled Confirm pickup button.

tagline: Drag the town map under a fixed pin and it snaps to the nearest curb.
summary: A ride-app style pickup picker: a drawn town slides under a central pin, the pin lifts while moving and drops onto the closest street, then the address and walking time appear with a confirm button.
appearance: A rounded dark card holds a square map of dark blocks and pale streets, a green park labelled Linden Park and a blue river. A white pin stands at the centre above a soft shadow, a blue dot marks you with a dashed walking line, and the address, walk time and a full-width button sit below.
behaviour: Pulling the map makes the pin lift off its shadow and the caption change to Move the map. On release the map springs to the nearest curb, pauses on Finding the curb, then the pin drops and the street name and walk time roll in; confirming turns the button green with Driver on the way.
demo_content: A drawn town with Grand Ave, Orchard Ave, Linden Park and Mill River; pickup at 386 Grand Ave.
search_phrases: ride app pickup map with a fixed pin
drag map to choose a pickup point
map pin that snaps to the nearest street
choose your location on a drawn map
map with a pin and walking time
drag to set a delivery address
use_when: A checkout or ride flow needs a precise street pickup instead of a free-text address.
avoid_when: Real-world mapping: the town is drawn in SVG and addresses are invented, not geocoded.
customise: Only a confirm callback and className are props; the drawn town, street names and walking scale are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A full SVG town plus motion springs while the map moves; it is static once the pin lands.

a11y.note: The map is a labelled button moved by arrow keys, the address is announced, and reduced motion drops the glide.

props.name: onConfirm
props.type: (pickup: { address: string; x: number; y: number }) => void

issues: Street names and the small locate control are faint against the dark map.
polish_why: Convincing ride-app pickup flow with a neat curb snap; the street labels are hard to read.
